description.summary: You touch one melee weapon and call forth the essence of its martial spirit
description.value: You touch one melee weapon and call forth the essence of its martial spirit. A duplicate weapon made of pure holy energy is manifested for every 3 levels you possess (to a maximum of 5 weapons). This does not affect power weapons. For the duration of the spell, if the target weapon successfully strikes a target, the duplicates also cause damage as they attack the victim. The duplicate weapons deal only the weapon’s base damage as holy damage; bonuses for Strength or other effects that would normally be applied to your attacks are not added. The spell is immediately dispelled if you no longer hold the weapon used for this spell (such as if you are disarmed or you give the weapon to another person).
